stages.mythic: Edit the concept and go much further. Keep the tall timber and stone gallery with its stair, its racks of great bows and sheaves of arrows, the barrel. Remove the archer completely, remove the mist, and replace both red cloth banners with rigid oak boards painted plain red on iron frames, without any sign. At the far left end of the lane rises the towering element: a colossal timber frame, four houses high, far above the gallery, stacking three giant round targets of woven straw and dark oak one above the other, largest at the bottom, all facing the viewer three-quarter like the concept targets. One arrow as long as a ship's mast sits in the dead centre of the top target, plain matte wood and iron. Strong magic layer, clear by day and by night: every giant target is ringed by a tall crown of pale blue-white cold flame, and long curling streaks of pale wind light run down the whole lane toward them. No glow on any bow or arrow. On the shooting line, a great bow rests alone on its stand, and the rope and stone trainer now lifts a block as big as a barrel. Nobody in the image, no people at all.
